items.title: Coffee Quest
items.description: Ten cafés across the Bay, from the old North Beach espresso bars to the Peninsula roasters. No two in the same town or neighbourhood.
targets: Red Blossom Tea — the tea one (Chinatown)

items.title: Croissant & Bakery Quest
items.description: Ten great Bay Area bakeries. Judge on the plain croissant where they make one, and on the thing they are famous for where they do not.

items.title: Market Quest
items.description: Six farmers markets. Buy at least one thing at each that you could not get in a supermarket.
